regions.today: Wednesday will begin rather wet and windy. Sunshine and scattered showers elsewhere will extend to all other areas through the day. Some heavy thundery falls will move in from the west during the evening hours. A blustery day, in a fresh to strong and gusty northwest wind, later easing. Cool with highest temperatures of 9 to 13 degrees.
regions.tonight: Scattered outbreaks of thundery rain with isolated thunderstorm will occur early tonight, clearing northeastwards overnight. Drier, clearer but colder weather will follow later. Lowest temperatures of 0 to 7 degrees, coldest away from west and southwest coasts; all in a light southwest or variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Thursday will start off dry with sunny spells apart from well scattered showers. However, very heavy rain will develop during the evening hours. Localised flooding is possible, especially south Leinster. Light to moderate east to northeast winds will gradually strengthen later too. Highest temperatures of 10 to 14 degrees.
